why_ai: Living crops are grown, spaced, scouted and shipped by hand inside greenhouses; demand is unaffected by AI.
why_clarity: Saleable plants by a bloom date are checkable, but crop response to setpoints shows only after weeks.
why_digital: Plants are physical products grown on benches and trucked to buyers, with climate computers assisting.

why_ai: Advisors walk customer greenhouses to assess pest pressure; their advice is why growers pick a supplier.
why_clarity: Release programmes follow IPM practice, but outcomes depend on pest dynamics seen weeks later.
why_digital: Work starts in greenhouse ranges and delivers release plans alongside shipped beneficial insects.

why_ai: State-licensed lab must physically test every batch and issue the legally decisive certificate.
why_clarity: A mandatory panel with codified methods yields pass or fail against fixed limits.
why_digital: Physical samples are analysed on instruments by in-state licensed labs; certificates are digital.

why_ai: Licensed facilities grow plants by hand under state rules; climate and nutrition run on grower intuition.
why_clarity: Yield and test results are measurable, but phenotype response emerges over a full cycle.
why_digital: Physical crop grown on site and sold in-state only, with seed-to-sale tracking alongside.

why_ai: Setpoint strategy built on telemetry is exactly what predictive optimisation software will absorb.
why_clarity: Setpoint effects on energy are immediate but crop outcomes are largely unjoined to the data.
why_digital: Minute-resolution telemetry in, configurations and strategies out, bundled with installed hardware.

why_ai: Dense sensor data plus thermodynamic models suit reinforcement learning, displacing grower setpoint intuition.
why_clarity: Energy cost is measured instantly, but setpoints are set by unarticulated grower feel.
why_digital: Sensor logs and setpoints are digital, while the result is a physical greenhouse climate.

why_ai: Harvesting, pruning and crop work stay hands-on, and demand for produce does not shift to AI.
why_clarity: Yield per square metre is measured weekly across standard crops like tomatoes and peppers.
why_digital: Physical produce grown in glasshouses and shipped to grocery chains across regions.

why_ai: Stamped structural and system designs for specific sites carry engineering liability and site judgement.
why_clarity: Each facility design is bespoke and as-built performance is rarely measured afterwards.
why_digital: Designs and energy models are produced in software, starting from site and crop conditions.

why_ai: Variety trials and protocols are run in physical greenhouses across sites by internal staff.
why_clarity: Trial outcomes on yield, quality and shrink arrive only at the end of crop cycles.
why_digital: Work starts from physical trials and delivers internal protocols to colocated production teams.

why_ai: Member-contributed price data is the moat; compiling indices and commentary is routine and automatable.
why_clarity: Weekly price and volume series follow a fixed method each reporting cycle.
why_digital: Reported prices collected and published as digital indices and reports.

why_ai: Family nurseries grow landscape plants by hand outdoors and sell through community relationships.
why_clarity: Saleable plants are checkable, but practice passes informally between family generations.
why_digital: Cash-heavy, Spanish-first operations with paper records and face-to-face selling.

why_ai: Physical substrate and tissue tests need lab instruments, though interpretation against ranges is automatable.
why_clarity: Nutrient, pH and EC values are measured by standard methods against published sufficiency ranges.
why_digital: Mailed physical samples in, digital analysis reports out to growers nationwide.

why_ai: Funding research and summarising it for members is administrative and summarisation work AI handles.
why_clarity: Value of funded research to growers is diffuse and shows up years later, if ever.
why_digital: Research libraries and survey data go out as digital summaries and conference talks.

why_ai: A retired head grower's career of crop observations, delivered on site, is the product.
why_clarity: Setpoint intuition cannot be articulated, and every site visit diagnoses a different problem.
why_digital: Advice is given walking the client's greenhouse, found through grower word of mouth.

why_ai: Scouts walk ranges inspecting plants by eye; camera-based detection can cover much of it by 2031.
why_clarity: Pest counts at sampling points repeat daily and can be confirmed under magnification.
why_digital: Work starts from live plants in the greenhouse and ends in a scouting record.

why_ai: Analysts' replenishment plans are automatable, but the field workforce culls and restocks plants in stores.
why_clarity: Sell-through and shrink by store-week-SKU give measurable outcomes within a short season.
why_digital: POS data drives plans, while restocking and merchandising happen physically inside garden centres.

why_ai: State inspectors must physically examine stock and personally issue the certificate shipments require.
why_clarity: Inspection follows pest-specific protocols with a clear certificate or quarantine outcome.
why_digital: Inspectors visit nurseries in person under state programmes; certificates are the only document output.

why_ai: New genetics must be bred and trialled in physical greenhouses across locations and seasons.
why_clarity: Variety success against environment is known only after multi-year, multi-location trials.
why_digital: Plants and cuttings are physical products sold through global breeders and brokers.

why_ai: Flowering crops are grown and finished by hand to biological deadlines; AI does not substitute plants.
why_clarity: Bloom by a holiday window is checkable, but timing depends on weeks of biological response.
why_digital: Potted plants grown on benches and shipped to big-box and garden-centre buyers.

why_ai: Pathologists confirm pathogens from physical tissue, including look-alike disorders, where errors mean discarded crops.
why_clarity: Pathogen identification is confirmable by culture or test, though symptoms vary widely.
why_digital: Physical tissue samples are shipped in; diagnostic reports go back electronically.

why_ai: Owner-operators vent, water and grow by hand and sell face to face to local customers.
why_clarity: Mixed retail, wholesale and landscaping work runs on memory and paper records.
why_digital: Manual climate control, paper records and local walk-in retail sales.

why_ai: Highly controlled, automated indoor environments still need hands for seeding, harvest and packing.
why_clarity: Energy-to-yield ratio is measured per cycle in a fully controlled, repeatable environment.
why_digital: Dense sensor data, but the product is fresh produce delivered to local buyers.
